program_name: Apple One (1) Year Limited Warranty (Mac; U.S.)
coverage_summary: Mac computers bought in the U.S. (MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, iMac, Mac mini, Mac Studio, Mac Pro), for faults in the first year
watch_phrases: BY USING YOUR MAC PRODUCT, YOU ARE AGREEING TO BE BOUND BY THE TERMS OF THE APPLE 1 YEAR LIMITED WARRANTY
warrants the Apple-branded hardware product and Apple-branded accessories contained in the original packaging
coverage: Defects in materials and workmanship when used normally in accordance with Apple's published guidelines, for one year from the date of original retail purchase by the end-user purchaser. This includes Apple-branded accessories in the original packaging
remedy: At Apple's option: repair with new or previously used Apple genuine parts, replacement with the same model (or with your consent a product with the same or substantially similar features), or a refund of the purchase price
mandatory_conditions: The claim is submitted to Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider during the one-year Warranty Period
The fault is a defect in materials or workmanship, with the Mac used normally in line with Apple's published guidelines
Apple or its agents may require proof of purchase details and may ask diagnostic questions before service
Back up the Mac first: during warranty service the contents of its storage may be lost, replaced or reformatted
exclusions_and_caveats: Not covered: damage caused by accident, abuse, misuse, fire, liquid contact, earthquake or other external cause

Not covered: cosmetic damage (scratches, dents, broken plastic on ports) and batteries or protective coatings that diminish over time, unless the failure is due to a defect in materials or workmanship

Not covered: damage from a third-party component that doesn't meet the Mac's specifications, from service by anyone other than Apple or an Apple Authorized Service Provider, or a Mac modified without Apple's written permission
Not covered: software, including the system software, and non-Apple branded hardware, even if sold with the Mac
Not covered: defects caused by normal wear and tear or normal aging, or a Mac whose serial number has been removed or defaced
Service is limited to the options available in the country where you ask for it, and you may pay shipping if the Mac can't be serviced there
This is the U.S. version of Apple's Mac warranty. Other countries have their own version, and consumer law may give you further rights
claim_action: Contact Apple Support, or visit an Apple Store or Apple Authorized Service Provider, before {deadline}. To see your coverage, sign in at mysupport.apple.com. Back up the Mac first and have proof of purchase ready.
visible_damage_note: Visible physical damage was recorded in the evidence photo. Apple's Mac warranty does not cover damage caused by accident, liquid contact or other external causes; AppleCare coverage, if you have it, may.
